---
title: Connect Claude to Slack
roles: all
item: I1
action: |
  1. Open Claude, go to Settings, then Connectors, and connect Slack.
  2. Give your own Claude this prompt. It creates the channel the copilot reads your reports in.
     ```
     Using your Slack connector, create a private Slack channel named {channelName}. If a channel with that name already exists, use it.
     ```
  3. In that channel in Slack, send this message: /invite {botMention}
  4. Once the copilot has confirmed it is in the channel, tell your Claude to send a welcome message to {channelName}.
check: I tick this step when I see the message from Claude. If I do not, click I did it and confirm.
---
Open Claude, go to Settings, then Connectors, and connect Slack. Then mention Claude in a channel.
